title: artanthe geniculata
intro: Artanthe geniculata, commonly known as the 'Calabar bean', is a plant species native to tropical regions of West Africa. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of pain, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Artanthe geniculata include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in managing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phytochemicals such as alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which have been found to exhibit potential medicinal properties.
